export const inOrderSteps = async <E,>(items: (() => Promise<void>)[], {reason}: Options): Promise<void> => { for (const item of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await client.put(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await audit.save(item);
} };

inOrderSteps([], {reason: "Each update reads the previous write"});
